verdict.rationale: Check documents its own report generation: one of its 30+ embeddable Components 'generate reports', and the MCP server can 'generate reports' and produce CSVs, though the CSV example is employee W-4 data, not payroll. Its CLI can also query payroll data as JSON for further analysis. None of the evidence names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports specifically, or describes how those reports are exported. missing for 10: documented payroll register report, documented gross-to-net report, explicit export formats (CSV/XLSX) for payroll reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
